summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Gwendolyn Wright, an architectural historian. It covers her education: a 1969 BA in history and art history from New York University, followed by graduate study at the University of California, Berkeley, where she earned an M.Arch in 1974 and a PhD in Architecture in 1978. It also notes that she published her first book in 1980.
